1,105 reviews. 4.2 stars. And most tourists never leave the beach to see it.

Phu Quoc National Park is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve covering the majority of the island. Evergreen forest, rare wildlife, unique marine species. The real Phu Quoc is in here.

Beach days are great. This is the other side of the island worth half a day of your trip.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
